sysmes_root_evidence: All four offsets were re-verified as whole-string roots on 2026-10-23 by parsing the owner's own configst.cpk (Google Drive, 376,960 bytes) with sysmes_text.sysmes_blob + sysmes_pack.parse: sysmes.bin 51,280 bytes, count 1182, string base 9468. offset 21488 = entry 360 (id 909, JP halfwidth Main Pilot), 21500 = entry 361 (id 143, Sub Pilot), 46264 = entry 1110 (id 1102, JP ＠4所持数), 31988 = entry 668 (id 528, JP 所持数). Each JP string has exactly one root in the pool, so no duplicate-root conflict can arise. The adjacent row sysmes:...:46267 (JP 所持数) is a byte fragment inside entry 1110 and is deliberately not edited, the same fail-closed rule as all previous sysmes plans.

measurements.pilot_label_field: Owner screenshot 1 (822x688 crop): the dark panel under the portrait spans image x165-490 (326 px); the game's fixed-width glyph advance is ~32.5 px/cell, so the field holds 10 cells exactly (EN 'Main Pilot' = 10). The centred 12-cell 'Główny pilot' spans ink x133-510 and overflows about one cell on each side, crossing into the HIT/EVA column. The sibling label 'Drugi pilot' (11 cells) shares the same field whenever a sub pilot is shown, so it is shortened in the same batch.
measurements.owned_footer_field: Owner screenshot 3 (1219x106 crop): 'Posiadane' (9 cells) starts at glyph-cell 0 with advance ~32.6 px/cell; the cyan 'Lv1' block is drawn at a fixed position whose 'L' occupies glyph-cell 8, colliding with the final 'e'. JP ＠4所持数 occupies 6 cells and EN '＠4Owned' 5, both clear of cell 8. Budget: at most 7 cells so one empty cell remains before Lv1. The plain sibling 所持数 (entry 668, no colour token) gets the same short form for consistency with the intsys_04 texture caption Owned='Masz' already shipped since v2.4.
